target.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android Settings did not expose the Skill Workshop review queue, so mobile users could not inspect generated skill proposals or perform the same core proposal lifecycle actions available from the Web UI. This left proposal review dependent on desktop/Web access even when the Android app was already connected to a Gateway.

## Summary

- Add a dedicated Android Settings > Skill Workshop panel for proposal review.
- Load proposal lists and details through existing Gateway `skills.proposals.*` RPCs with agent-scope support.
- Auto-load selected proposal details to match Web controller behavior.
- Support pending proposal lifecycle actions from mobile: apply, reject, and quarantine.
- Gate apply/reject/quarantine on granted `operator.admin` scope in both UI and Runtime paths.
- Add Settings home summary counts and filtering/search/admin-gate helper coverage.

## Implementation Notes

- The Android UI uses a mobile list/detail layout rather than the Web desktop board layout.
- No new Gateway API is introduced; Android reuses the existing Skill Workshop RPC methods.
- Gateway responses are guarded against stale list/detail updates during gateway changes.
- Native app i18n inventory was updated for the new Android Settings strings.
- `GatewayHelloSummary` now carries auth role/scopes so Android can fail closed when proposal mutation actions lack `operator.admin`.

## Evidence

- Local static checks passed on the PR branch:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `git diff --cached --check`
  - `pnpm native:i18n:check`
  - `pnpm android:i18n:check`
- Added unit coverage for Skill Workshop settings summary, filtering helpers, operator scope normalization, and admin-gated proposal actions in `ShellScreenLogicTest`.
- GitHub Actions passed on commit `2a6c453457c1910e0a64ee79db29eec0068dac30`:
  - CI: `native-i18n`, `android-ktlint`, `android-build-play`, `android-test-play`, `android-test-third-party`, Node shards, QA smoke shards, check shards, docs, security, and preflight passed.
  - Real behavior proof passed.
  - Workflow Sanity, OpenGrep PR diff, Dependency Guard, Security Sensitive Guard, Socket PR alerts, and ClawSweeper Dispatch passed.

## Real Media Evidence

- Real GitHub Actions Android media proof run in `snowzlmbot/openclaw`: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28915907881
- Evidence media branch: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/tree/evidence/pr-101911-real-actions-media/pr-101911-actions-media
- Captured screenshot: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-actions-media/pr-101911-actions-media/real-actions-openclaw-skill-workshop-latest-head.png
- Proof details:
  - Proof target includes latest PR head `2a6c453457c1910e0a64ee79db29eec0068dac30` plus proof-only workflow/screenshot-scene files.
  - The proof workflow built the Android Play debug APK and captured a 1080x2400 PNG on a GitHub-hosted Android API 35 emulator.
  - The proof-only screenshot scene is not part of the upstream PR code branch; it exists only to let `snowzlmbot/openclaw` Actions capture deterministic Android media for this new Settings surface.

## Not Run Locally

- Android ktlint/build/tests were not run locally because this environment has no `java`/`JAVA_HOME` available. Android verification was run in GitHub Actions instead.

## Risk

- Moderate UI/RPC surface change isolated to Android Settings and existing Skill Workshop Gateway methods.
- Proposal mutation actions now fail closed without `operator.admin`, reducing accidental privileged action exposure.
- No dependency, workflow, release, or Gateway API surface changes in the PR branch.
